Ideas for second chart:
- Relationship lengths/success rate by season
- How met partner by season? (Could be used to show which method sees "cuffing season" the most)

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(ggridges)
library(ggdist)
library(ggmosaic)
library(waffle)

ggplot(cuffing_data, aes(x = w1_q21b_month, y = w1_age_at_relstart_cat)) + 
  geom_density_ridges()
ggplot(cuffing_data, aes(x = w1_q21b_month, y = w1_age_at_relstart_cat)) + 
  geom_dots()
ggplot(cuffing_data, aes(x = w1_q21b_month, y = w1_age_at_relstart_cat)) + 
  geom_dots()

# need to filter NAs out for this chart for w1_q21b_year values.

cuffing_na_out <- cuffing_data |> 
  filter(w1_q21b_year < 2018)

p1 <- ggplot(cuffing_na_out) +
  geom_mosaic(aes(weight = w1_weight_combo, x = w1_age_at_relstart_cat, fill = relstart_season)) +
  theme_mosaic()
p1

p2 <- ggplot(cuffing_na_out) +
  geom_mosaic(aes(weight = w1_weight_combo, x = w1_age_at_relstart_cat, fill = met_season)) +
  theme_mosaic()
p2

library(patchwork)

p1 + p2

```
